name: topical-passage-classifier-chirho
description: Data pipeline for topical Bible passage search model using Nave's and TSK cross-references

scripts.download-all-chirho: bun run src-chirho/data-chirho/download-naves-chirho.ts && bun run src-chirho/data-chirho/download-kjv-chirho.ts && bun run src-chirho/data-chirho/download-crossrefs-chirho.ts
scripts.build-all-chirho: bun run download-all-chirho && bun run build-dataset-chirho && bun run validate-chirho
